gmcm.seenAndHeardEnabledTooltip: Nearby NPCs remember actions they witness and can mention them in dialogue and gossip. No SpaceCore dependency.
gmcm.seenAndHeardFishingChanceTooltip: Chance that an eligible nearby NPC stops to fish with you after noticing you fishing. 0% disables this reaction; 100% always attempts it.
gmcm.seenAndHeardGroupChatChanceTooltip: Chance that two NPCs standing together pull you into a group conversation when you enter their location. Rolled once per location per day. 0% disables group conversations.
gmcm.seenAndHeardNpcMovementTooltip: Villagers indoors remember other villagers arriving where they are, so they can mention who came and went. Off by default: it records many small events and only matters for what villagers know about each other.
gmcm.seenAndHeardFriendshipEffectsToolti: A feeling that reaches you (said on a walk-over or brought up when you talk) changes friendship: confrontations cost 10/25/50 points by level, fondness and affection give 10/25 from level 2, and a great laugh gives 10. Off by default.
gmcm.seenAndHeardMoodEffectsTooltip: A feeling that reaches level 2 or more changes the villager's mood for the rest of the day: irritated with you after a confrontation, pleased after fondness or affection. It only changes the tone of what they say.
gmcm.seenAndHeardTextInsteadOfWalk: Text when they can't reach you
gmcm.seenAndHeardTextInsteadOfWalkToolti: When a villager meant to walk over about something they witnessed but couldn't reach you (you left the map first, or the moment passed), a villager with a phone texts you on the Messenger instead of waiting for the next conversation. One AI text, counted in the Messenger's weekly allowance. Off by default.
gmcm.seenAndHeardColdShoulderTooltip: Within an hour of game time after a villager told you off at the strongest level, trying to talk to them gets no conversation: they turn their back, show an angry bubble and say one short line (no AI). Once per villager per day; after that they talk as usual. Off by default.
gmcm.seenAndHeardBubblesTooltip: Instead of walking over to talk, a villager reacts to small things they see (staring at them, blocking their way, a splash of water, a kiss in public, swimming, sitting on their chair, touching their things) with a short line in a speech bubble over their head, with no AI call. The event is still remembered and can still bring them over when it builds up. On by default.

gmcm.sceneEventsEnabledTooltip: Small everyday moments between villagers. A villager who is already nearby may walk over to chat, or you may overhear villagers talking among themselves. With AI available the lines are generated on the spot; otherwise prewritten lines are used.
gmcm.sceneEventDeliveryStyleTooltip: How the built-in scene events play out. Natural: villagers who are already nearby walk over to chat or talk among themselves, with no cutscene. Ambient only: you just overhear them and nobody walks over to you. Cinematic: the classic cutscenes that move you and the NPCs into place. Experimental mode intros always play as cutscenes.
gmcm.maxSceneEventsPerDayTooltip: Maximum scene events planned per day, at most one per location (0-5). A planned scene only happens if its villagers are actually there. 0 = none.
gmcm.sceneEventsRecordMemoryTooltip: When you witness a scene event, the villagers in it keep a short memory of it and your diary and the evening gossip know you were there. No extra AI call.
gmcm.gossipEnabledTooltip: Enable the NPC gossip/collective memory system
gmcm.gossipPlayerFocusTooltip: How much the nightly gossip is about you. Normal: gossip comes from your day. Balanced: villagers first, you only when you do something out of the ordinary. Villagers only: gossip is about the villagers, you are at most mentioned in passing, and villagers meet a little more often. Your diary is not affected.
gmcm.compactionIntervalTooltip: Days between memory compactions (5-15 days, default 15)
gmcm.acceptThirdPartyGossipTooltip: Let other mods (e.g. a smartphone/news integration) inject gossip notes that AliveNpcs analyzes at day-end, separate from EC modes. Off = only AliveNpcs' own gossip and EC gossip.
gmcm.thirdPartyGossipLimitTooltip: Maximum third-party gossip notes accepted per day (separate sink from EC gossip). 0 = none.
gmcm.experimentalDialogueModeTooltip: Only one experimental mode can be active at a time. Off adds no extra prompt block.
gmcm.experimentalDialogueModeIntro: Select an experimental mode to enrich dialogue, story arcs, and NPC personalities. Each mode adds custom prompt blocks, safety-guarded content, and optional story arcs. Change requires a reload to take full effect.
gmcm.experimentalDialogueModeNoneDescrip: No experimental mode active. Dialogue, story arcs, and NPC personalities run with their default AliveNpcs behavior.
gmcm.experimentalContentSelectorTooltip: Open the visual experimental content selector with mode descriptions and safety profiles.
gmcm.experimentalDialogueModeHelp: An Alien in the Valley: you came from another galaxy to plant parsnips. Mayor Mode: Pelican Town thinks Lewis retired and you are mayor now. Slasher Mode: spooky rumors wonder what is under the farm soil. Valley Heartthrob: you are irresistible. Valley Heartthrob (Cute): they think you look good, but keep it sweet. Vampire Mode - Do You Sparkle in the Sun?: maybe your charm needs sunscreen. Yandere Mode: too much affection, not enough common sense.
gmcm.socialDramaEnabledTooltip: Allow gossip to change NPC opinions and create sharper social tension.
gmcm.dynamicPersonalitiesTooltip: NPC personalities can slowly evolve from repeated interactions in this save.
gmcm.dynamicOrientationDiscoveryTooltip: Adult NPCs can privately question or recognize attraction after repeated respectful flirts. On by default.
gmcm.npcNpcRomancesTooltip: Adult NPC social moments can slowly become crushes or romantic curiosity. On by default.
gmcm.adultRelationshipDramaTooltip: Enable adult-only relationship conflict such as marital tension and risky attraction. Off by default.
gmcm.allowInfidelityArcsTooltip: Allow affair-contemplation states only when adult drama is also enabled. Off by default.
gmcm.protectCanonicalMarriagesTooltip: Keep canon marriages from escalating into affair arcs.
gmcm.relationshipProposalsTooltip: Allow dating and marriage proposals through free-text dialogue. Bouquet and pendant still work.
gmcm.relationshipDatingProposalsTooltip: Show the Ask to date option for eligible NPCs.
gmcm.relationshipMarriageProposalsToolti: Show the Propose marriage option for eligible dating NPCs.
gmcm.proposalRejectionCooldownTooltip: Days before the player can ask again after a rejection.
gmcm.requireHouseForDialogueMarriageTool: Require the vanilla house upgrade before dialogue marriage proposals.
gmcm.inviteOutActionTooltip: Show a dialogue action to invite eligible NPCs to spend time together. It is social by default, not necessarily romantic.
gmcm.inviteOutMinHeartsTooltip: Minimum hearts required before the Hang out action appears. 0 = no minimum.
gmcm.inviteOutAcceptedCooldownTooltip: Days before the player can invite the same NPC again after they accept.
gmcm.inviteOutRejectedCooldownTooltip: Days before the player can invite the same NPC again after they refuse.
gmcm.inviteOutCompletionFriendshipToolti: Friendship points earned when a hang out scene actually plays. 0 disables it.
gmcm.socialDramaIntensityTooltip: How strongly gossip can shift opinions: Cozy, Balanced, or Telenovela.
gmcm.opinionShiftsFromGossipTooltip: NPCs can become annoyed, suspicious, protective, or cold based on gossip they know.
gmcm.playerIntrigueActionsTooltip: The farmer can nudge NPC opinions by praising, defending, warning, or badmouthing other villagers in dialogue.
gmcm.npcBadmouthingTooltip: NPCs with enough social tension may privately vent or make sharper comments.
gmcm.skipPointsTooltip: Friendship points when skipping a conversation (Skip button)
gmcm.maxFriendshipPointsPerInteractionTo: Maximum friendship points awarded per AI interaction (0-100). Set to 0 to disable friendship points entirely.
gmcm.turnsPerConversationTooltip: Maximum turns per NPC conversation (1 = single turn, up to 50). Recommended: 3 to 10. Longer conversations send more history with every reply, so they use more tokens and answers get slower.
gmcm.maxSpouseConversationsPerDayTooltip: Maximum separate AI conversation openings with the current spouse each day.
gmcm.enableHotSpouseScenesTooltip: Opt in to adult, consensual, non-graphic spouse_hot scenes.
gmcm.itemRequestDialogueChanceTooltip: Chance that an eligible first dialogue asks for a small item favor and adds it to the normal quest log.
gmcm.itemRequestCooldownDaysTooltip: Days an NPC waits after a completed item request before asking for another item (0 = no cooldown).
gmcm.npcInteractionsTooltip: NPCs generate daily micro-interactions with each other
gmcm.dynamicNpcFriendshipsTooltip: NPCs can build friendships, tension, and unlikely social moments beyond scripted relationship pairs.
gmcm.maxActiveArcsTooltip: Maximum number of active story arcs at the same time (each analysis uses 1 API call per week)
gmcm.enableArcConclusionSceneTooltip: Play arc conclusions as vanilla in-game events with default dialogue bubbles.
gmcm.enableMockArcsTooltip: Load debug story arcs on startup for testing the arc system.
gmcm.postResolutionDialogueExpiryDaysToo: How many days after arc resolution NPCs will comment on what happened.
gmcm.arcFizzleThresholdSeasonsTooltip: Seasons without progress before an arc automatically fizzles out.
gmcm.weeklyNewsTooltip: Generate village news weekly (uses 1 API call per week)
gmcm.diaryScrapbookTooltip: Pastes fan art of the villagers, made by independent artists, on the diary entries that mention them. Hover an art to see who drew it.
gmcm.diaryOpeningTooltip: The diary opens closed, showing this season's cover, and the cover turns open. Click or press any key to skip it.
gmcm.lettersEnabledTooltip: Enable NPC letters and mailbox delivery.
gmcm.letterHeartMilestonesTooltip: Heart levels at which a villager writes you a letter, separated by commas (default: 3, 6, 8, 10).
gmcm.letterMissYouDaysTooltip: A villager with 6+ hearts writes after this many days without talking to you.
gmcm.eventLettersTooltip: Villagers also write after a story arc ends, a few days after a festival, after a loved birthday present and after going out together.
gmcm.showTokenUsageTooltip: Shows token totals and API request counts in the hub and AI Status tab. Disabled by default.
gmcm.maxNpcInteractionsPerDayTooltip: Maximum NPC↔NPC interactions per day (some can use local templates)
gmcm.npcSocialChaosLevelTooltip: How often the village tries unlikely NPC pairings (0 = safest, 100 = most experimental).
gmcm.npcSocialRareMomentChanceTooltip: Chance that an unlikely pairing becomes a rare or funny social moment.
gmcm.npcSocialTemplateOnlyChanceTooltip: Chance that common NPC social moments use a local template instead of an AI call.
gmcm.allowNpcSocialGossipTooltip: Allow public NPC-to-NPC moments to be marked as gossip context for future dialogue.

gmcm.nvidiaNimModelTooltip: NVIDIA NIM model ID. Default: nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b.
gmcm.customLlmHelp: For local or generic LLMs, select OpenAI-compatible/local and fill the URL/model below. Gemini settings are still kept for fallback or switching back.
gmcm.customLlmPresetTooltip: Quickly fill URL/model defaults for common OpenAI-compatible local servers.
gmcm.customLlmPresetHelp: After choosing a preset, adjust the model name if your local server uses a different model. Use the AI Status tab in the hub to test latency.
gmcm.customLlmBaseUrlTooltip: Base URL for an OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1.

gmcm.customLlmApiKeyTooltip: Optional. Leave empty for local servers that do not require a key.

gmcm.customLlmSystemPromptTooltip: Disable if your local server only accepts user messages.
gmcm.customLlmReloadConfigEachRequest: Reload custom LLM config from config.json each request
gmcm.customLlmReloadConfigEachRequestToo: When enabled, custom URL/model/API key/system-prompt/timeout settings are reloaded for each request (only when this provider is selected as the primary provider).
gmcm.apiKeyCountTooltip: Set how many key fields are active (1-20). Default is 2.
gmcm.apiKeySlotTooltip: Gemini API key for this slot.
gmcm.apiKeySlotDisabledTooltip: Increase the key count slider to enable this field.

gmcm.geminiThinkingTooltip: Allows supported Gemini models to use internal thinking tokens. Off by default to reduce latency and stalls.

observatory.title: Maru's Observatory
observatory.intro: Clear skies tonight! Click a constellation and I'll tell you its legend.
observatory.hint: Click a constellation: legend   Arrows or LB/RB: next one
observatory.quiet: Lately the town has been too quiet for new legends.
observatory.whisper.0: Maru swears the stars still whisper: "{{gossip}}"
observatory.whisper.1: On clear nights you can almost hear it say: "{{gossip}}"
observatory.whisper.2: Lately it twinkles whenever someone in town says: "{{gossip}}"
observatory.c.sword.name: {{npc}}'s Sword
observatory.c.sword.lore: Long ago, {{npc}} swung her sword at a slime so hard that the blade flew up and stuck in the sky.
observatory.c.bird.name: {{npc}}'s Bird
observatory.c.bird.lore: {{npc}} sewed a dress so bright that a bird put it on and flew off to live among the stars.
observatory.c.camera.name: {{npc}}'s Camera
observatory.c.camera.lore: {{npc}} took a photo of the night with the flash on, and the sparkle never came back down.
observatory.c.rod.name: {{npc}}'s Fishing Rod
observatory.c.rod.lore: {{npc}} cast his line on a calm night and hooked a star. He says he's still reeling it in.
observatory.c.frog.name: {{npc}}'s Frog
observatory.c.frog.lore: A frog hopped off {{npc}}'s motorcycle one rainy night and landed right in the sky.
observatory.c.brush.name: {{npc}}'s Brush
observatory.c.brush.lore: {{npc}} painted the night itself, then left her brush up there to dry.
observatory.c.anvil.name: {{npc}}'s Anvil
observatory.c.anvil.lore: {{npc}} hit his anvil so hard one night that the sparks never stopped flying.
observatory.c.telescope.name: {{npc}}'s Telescope
observatory.c.telescope.lore: {{npc}} looked through her telescope for so long that the sky built one of its own to look back.
observatory.c.campfire.name: {{npc}}'s Campfire
observatory.c.campfire.lore: {{npc}}'s campfire burned so warm one winter that its smoke turned into stars.
observatory.c.book.name: {{npc}}'s Book
observatory.c.book.lore: {{npc}} read a story aloud by the river, and the stars leaned in so close to listen that they stayed.
observatory.c.stardrop.name: The Stardrop
observatory.c.stardrop.lore: The very first Stardrop fell from this spot, and the hole it left behind still glows.
observatory.c.parsnip.name: The Great Parsnip
observatory.c.parsnip.lore: The first parsnip ever planted in the valley kept growing until it reached the night.
observatory.c.pumpkin.name: The Giant Pumpkin
observatory.c.pumpkin.lore: A pumpkin grew so big for Spirit's Eve that it rolled right off the farm and into the sky.
observatory.c.starfruit.name: The Starfruit
observatory.c.starfruit.lore: Someone ate a Starfruit on this hill, and its seeds took root among the stars.
observatory.c.shard.name: The Prismatic Shard
observatory.c.shard.lore: A Prismatic Shard cracked in two up here and scattered its colors across the whole sky.
slimeduel.title: Slime Duel
slimeduel.krobus.intro.1: Ah, a visitor. Shall our slimes play? I never lose. Well, rarely.
slimeduel.krobus.intro.2: The shadows told me you would come. They also said you'd lose.
slimeduel.krobus.intro.3: My slimes ate the sewer rats for breakfast. Ready?
slimeduel.krobus.waiting.1: Take your time. I live in a sewer. I have plenty of it.
slimeduel.krobus.waiting.2: I can smell your fear. Or the sewer. Hard to tell.
slimeduel.krobus.waiting.3: Fire, water or grass? I already know. Probably.
slimeduel.krobus.winround.1: Hehe. The shadows guided that one.
slimeduel.krobus.winround.2: Did that hurt? {{name}} says sorry. It doesn't mean it.
slimeduel.krobus.loseround.3: You've been practising. With whom? Tell me.
slimeduel.krobus.tie.1: The same element? Are you copying me?
slimeduel.krobus.crit.2: A critical hit! Even I flinched.
slimeduel.krobus.crit.3: That one will leave a stain.
slimeduel.krobus.faintmine.2: No! {{name}} was my favourite. Don't tell the others.
slimeduel.krobus.faintmine.3: {{name}} melts away... but I have more.
slimeduel.krobus.faintyours.1: {{name}} is out. Shall I send flowers?
slimeduel.krobus.faintyours.2: Your {{name}} is a puddle now. A cute puddle.
slimeduel.krobus.faintyours.3: One down. The shadows are pleased.
slimeduel.krobus.victory.1: I win! I will tell the sewer rats about this.
slimeduel.krobus.victory.2: Victory belongs to the shadows. Come back anytime, friend.
slimeduel.krobus.victory.3: Good game. Mine was better, of course.
slimeduel.krobus.defeat.1: You beat me... Fine. You are a worthy friend.
slimeduel.krobus.defeat.3: My slimes demand a rematch. So do I.
slimeduel.krobus.rematch.1: Again? Good. I was going easy before.
slimeduel.krobus.rematch.3: The shadows want a second round.

characterSheet.birthdayHint: Your birthday. On that day villagers text you and mail you a present. Festival days are skipped.
birthday.text.friend.1: Hey {{player}}, happy birthday! Hope the farm lets you take it easy today, you earned it.
birthday.text.friend.2: Happy birthday, {{player}}! Don't spend the whole day working, okay? Do something fun.
birthday.text.friend.3: {{player}}!! It's your birthday! Happy birthday, I hope it's a good one.
birthday.text.friend.4: Just remembered what day it is. Happy birthday, {{player}}. Glad you ended up in this valley.
birthday.text.romance.1: Good morning, birthday person. Thinking about you already, {{player}}. Happy birthday!
birthday.text.romance.2: Happy birthday, {{player}}. I wanted to be the first to say it. Find me later, okay?
birthday.text.romance.3: It's your birthday and I can't stop smiling. Happy birthday, {{player}}. You make this place better.
birthday.text.romance.4: Happy birthday, {{player}}! I have a feeling today is going to be a good one. Come see me when you can.
birthday.text.spouse.1: Happy birthday, my love. I'll make today a good one for you, I promise. Love you, {{player}}.
birthday.text.spouse.2: You left before I could say it properly: happy birthday, {{player}}! Don't be late tonight.
birthday.text.spouse.3: Happy birthday, {{player}}. Of all the days in the year, this one is my favourite because of you.
birthday.text.spouse.4: It's your birthday and I'm already missing you. Happy birthday, {{player}}. Come home early today.
birthday.letter.friend.1: Dear {{player}},^^Happy birthday! I thought about what you might like and sent a little something along with this letter. It isn't much, but it comes with a smile.^^Have a wonderful day.
birthday.letter.friend.2: {{player}},^^It's your birthday, so no working too hard today, alright? There's a small present in this envelope. I hope it suits you.^^Happy birthday, from your friend.
birthday.letter.friend.3: Dear {{player}},^^Another year, and the valley is lucky to have you in it. Here's a little gift to mark the day.^^Happy birthday!
birthday.letter.friend.4: Hi {{player}},^^I wanted this to reach you first thing in the morning. Happy birthday! The present is small, but I picked it with you in mind.^^Enjoy your day.
birthday.letter.romance.1: Dear {{player}},^^Happy birthday. I couldn't wait to see you to tell you, so here it is in writing, with a little present inside. I hope you think of me when you open it.^^Yours, always.
birthday.letter.romance.2: {{player}},^^It's your birthday and I've been smiling about it since I woke up. There's a gift in here for you. It's nothing grand, but it's from the heart.^^Come find me later, I want to see you.
birthday.letter.romance.3: My dear {{player}},^^Happy birthday! I wanted to give you this in person, but I also wanted it to be the first thing you found today. So here it is, with all my affection.^^Have a beautiful day.
birthday.letter.romance.4: Dear {{player}},^^Today is about you. Happy birthday! I sent along something I hope you'll like. Save a little of your day for me, will you?^^With love.
birthday.letter.spouse.1: My love,^^Happy birthday, {{player}}! I know I'll see you at home, but I wanted you to find this in the mailbox too, with a present picked just for you.^^I love you. Come home early.
birthday.letter.spouse.2: {{player}},^^Happy birthday to the best thing that ever happened to me. There's a gift in here; it's small, but so is a ring, and look how that turned out.^^All my love.
birthday.letter.spouse.3: Dear {{player}},^^It's your birthday, and I wanted to spoil you a little. Open the present, take the day slow, and let me take care of the rest.^^Happy birthday, my love.
birthday.letter.spouse.4: My dearest {{player}},^^Another year with you. Happy birthday! I sent a little present ahead so the day starts right.^^Yours, today and every day.
